title: Wild Curry Chicken
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dish made with wild chicken, rich tahini sauce, and aromatic curry spices.
instructions: Season the wild chicken breast with salt and Indian curry powder.
Heat coconut oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken cooks, whisk together tahini, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken against the grain and serve with the tahini sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
